name: dbt platform
sku: dbt platform Starter plan. The platform runs the dbt framework as v1 or v2, so the bundle takes the framework from the dbt OSS record and the dbt v2 additions, and the hosted services from dbt-platform-services.

presentation.tagline: The dbt framework plus a hosted scheduler, CI, catalog, semantic layer and IDE.

cost.note: The free Developer plan (1 seat, 3,000 model builds/month) covers a solo prototype; one Starter seat at $100/user/month if you need more.

Enterprise is negotiated, typically $200-400/seat/month before volume discounts; third-party data cites a 20-seat Enterprise team paying $36,000-84,000/year ($3,000-7,000/month), and 25-100+ seat deals often settling at $150-250/seat/month with volume discounts.
